thread:
linda: Heads up - Customer 'NovaApps' flagged their March bill. They say ~420k embed tokens were client retries that should have been deduped. Ticket NVA-990.
frank: Do we have a sample timeframe or request keys?
linda: They provided a narrow window: 2026-03-12 18:40:00..18:55:00 UTC and a small CSV with client_request_key and server_request_id columns.
omar: Quick check against metering: I see a burst in that window from tenant nova-apps. Running aggregation now.
billing-bot: Query result: tenant=nova-apps window=2026-03-12T18:40..18:55 total_embed_tokens=1,102,410 suspect_duplicate_token_estimate=419,860 duplicate_groups=1,127
frank: That matches their claim closely. Any clue why dedup didn't catch it?
omar: We shipped a change on 2026-03-11 that enabled dedup by client_request_key for embeddings, but there was a short rollback on 03-12 for an unrelated latency regression. This window is during the rollback.
linda: So these were processed without the dedup rule. Customer wants a credit and a corrected invoice.
billing-bot: Policy note: pre-deploy windows where dedup not active are usually billable. However we make exceptions for clear retry storms when duplicates are obvious and customer provides logs.
frank: Let's be pragmatic. Engineering can run a targeted backfill to mark duplicates nonbillable for that tenant+window. What's the cost to run this?
omar: Estimate: 3-4 hours of engineer time for dry run + validation. Low DB risk if we only flip a `billable=false` flag for rows that match client_request_key dedup logic. We'll also coordinate suppressing downstream alerts for the reconciliation window.
linda: Finance needs an upfront estimate for the provisional credit and the GL code. What's the dollar value?
billing-bot: Estimate: duplicate_tokens=419,860 embed_rate=$0.00025/token projected_credit=$104.965 -> rounded $105.00 USD
frank: Can Finance approve a provisional credit of $105 while we validate the backfill? If final differs we reconcile on next invoice.
linda: I can approve provisional credit up to $120 to be safe. GL code 4-215-ADJ. Please include a short memo that notes the rollback caused the double billing.
omar: I'll run the backfill dry-run now and post reconciled CSV to the ticket within 24h. I'll also include a manifest of changed rows.
billing-bot: Action logged: provisional-credit-1803002020 amount=120 currency=USD requester=linda state=issued
linda: Support will inform the customer of provisional credit and ETA. Thanks team.
frank: Please also add a short postmortem note to the deploy change to prevent repeat rollbacks during critical billing windows.
omar: Will do.
